roles.application-contract: Keep application entry points and their value contracts usable outside SharpLink; they do not expose the retired Session engine.
roles.policy-spi: Keep external policy implementations and their input/result contracts accessible. Preserve each SPI ownership and synchronous/asynchronous calling contract.
roles.codec-spi: Keep standalone serialization and externally implementable codec/adapter services available without starting a Client/Server.
roles.generated-abi: Keep API5 cross-assembly generated bootstrap, codec and invocation contracts public. EditorBrowsable is not an access boundary.
roles.protocol-buffer-spi: Keep the Accepted ADR0001 protocol data, encoding and bounded buffer SPI; using these tools does not grant access to a live Session.
roles.configuration: Keep caller-configurable values and validation available through existing builder/configuration entry points; copying does not necessarily make an options object immutable.
roles.diagnostics: Keep observable state, stable codes and diagnostic snapshots readable by application consumers without exposing mutable engine state.
roles.transport-composition: Keep direct construction and composition of the built-in transport SPI, with existing ownership and platform limits.
roles.contract-metadata: Keep source-level contract annotations and metadata accessible to user assemblies and the SDK generator.
roles.hosting: Keep Generic Host/DI registration, accessors and health integration usable by applications without friendship or engine access.
roles.generation-control: Keep the explicit generation-control service, provider contract and serializable control-plane values public.
roles.internal-polymorphism: Keep actual internal/private base classes inheritable by their implementation family; no external visibility is added.
roles.generator-entry: Keep Roslyn generator discovery/construction public and the implementation sealed.
roles.legacy-helper: Keep the released helper capability instead of introducing an additional breaking removal without an equivalent replacement.
